channel.title: Location for an SCP
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "Location for an SCP" - I'm writing an SCP and want to know what site to put it at!

item.title: Re: Location for an SCP
item.content:encoded: Well, what's the SCP about? Is it unmovable or do you have a certain place in mind? I know this isn't the correct category to talk about it, but if you could give a minor description of where you have in mind of where you want it to be or what it is, then I'll be more than happy to help you with a location

item.title: I don't care which site as long as it's not Site-19
item.content:encoded: I think that almost any site that isn't Site-19 will work perfectly, for two reasons a) Site-19 isn't made for that kind of thing and b) people generally just take their scp and throw it in Site-19 whenever.

item.title: Re: Location for an SCP
item.content:encoded: Site functions are hardly consistent across articles and you'd be fine just listing a random one, or not saying one at all. We have the Secure Facilities Locations to document sites with some consistent lore, so maybe avoid those if need be.

item.title: Location for an SCP
item.content:encoded:
So I don't know if this is the right form or not but I have a question about where to put an SCP.

So the SCP I'm writing is a building anomaly (It's a shed) & want to know what the best site to put it at is.
The SCP was moved from where it was discovered by the foundation to a site.
